# graph-beautiful

Graph styling module for improved visual rendering.

Configures graph tick parameters, grid, legend, and common variable display
names to produce publication-quality plots. Import this module to apply
a clean and consistent graph style.

Usage:
```bash
%import graph-beautiful
```

Source: [`modules/graph-beautiful.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/graph-beautiful.npf)
